title: 高阳台·和周草窗寄越中诸友韵
title_en: Gao Yang Tai: Answering Zhou Caochuang's Lyric to Friends in Yue
author: 王沂孙

text_note.zh: 题目按通行本补上“和周草窗寄越中诸友韵”。“不知春在谁家”一句，有的版本作“不知春是谁家”。
text_note.en: The title follows the common text, which adds the occasion: answering Zhou Caochuang's lyric to friends in Yue. In the fifth line, some editions have a slightly different word that changes 'where spring is' to 'whose spring it is'.

readings.zh: 小帖，写着字的小纸片，“帖”读 tiě，和“请帖”的“帖”一样。
readings.en: It means a small written card, so the character is read tiě, as in an invitation card.

readings.zh: 现在读 xié。古音读 xiá，和“葭、家、遮、沙、华、涯、花”押韵。
readings.en: It is read xié today. In old times it was read xiá, which rhymed with the other line endings here such as jiā, zhē, shā and huā.

readings.zh: 殷勤，热情周到，“殷”读 yīn。
readings.en: It means warm and attentive, so the character is read yīn.

glosses.zh: 庭阴：院子里背阴的地方。
glosses.en: tíng yīn: the shady side of the courtyard.

glosses.zh: 帘影：帘子的影子。
glosses.en: lián yǐng: the shadow of the curtain.

glosses.zh: 霏霏：纷纷飘飞的样子。
glosses.en: fēi fēi: drifting and flying in a fine scatter.

glosses.zh: 玉管春葭：古人把芦苇膜烧成的灰放进玉做的律管里，到了某个节气，灰就会飞出来，说明节气到了。这里是说春天来了。
glosses.en: yù guǎn chūn jiā: people of old put ash from burned reed skin into jade pipes. When a new season arrived, the ash was said to fly out. Here it means spring has come.

glosses.zh: 小帖金泥：用金粉写字的小帖子。古时立春这天，人们会写这样的春帖贴在门上。
glosses.en: xiǎo tiě jīn ní: small cards written in gold paint. On the first day of spring, people of old wrote such spring cards and put them up on doors.

glosses.zh: 春在谁家：春天到了谁家呢？意思是春天来了，自己却感觉不到。
glosses.en: chūn zài shuí jiā: whose home has spring come to? It means spring is here, but the poet does not feel it.

glosses.zh: 奈：无奈，没办法。
glosses.en: nài: there is nothing one can do.

glosses.zh: 个人：那个人，指远方的朋友。
glosses.en: gè rén: that person, the friend far away.

glosses.zh: 水隔天遮：被江水隔开，被天边挡住，形容相隔很远。
glosses.en: shuǐ gé tiān zhē: cut off by water, hidden by the sky. It means very far apart.

glosses.zh: 凄然：伤心的样子。
glosses.en: qī rán: sad and heavy-hearted.

glosses.zh: 幽香：淡淡的清香，指梅花的香。
glosses.en: yōu xiāng: a faint, quiet scent, the scent of plum blossom.

glosses.zh: 横斜：横着斜着的影子，指梅枝的影子。宋代林逋写梅花有“疏影横斜”的名句。
glosses.en: héng xié: shadows lying across at a slant, the shadows of plum branches. The Song poet Lin Bu wrote a famous line about plum shadows lying slant.

glosses.zh: 自是：本来就是。
glosses.en: zì shì: is already, by its nature.

glosses.zh: 况：何况，更不用说。
glosses.en: kuàng: what is more, let alone.

glosses.zh: 游骢：远行人骑的马。骢，青白色的马。
glosses.en: yóu cōng: the horse of a traveler. Cōng is a blue-and-white horse.

glosses.zh: 平沙：平坦的沙滩。
glosses.en: píng shā: a flat sandy bank.

glosses.zh: 银笺：精美的信纸。
glosses.en: yín jiān: fine letter paper.

glosses.zh: 殷勤：热情、细心地。
glosses.en: yīn qín: warmly and with care.

glosses.zh: 年华：时光，这里指一年年过去的光景。
glosses.en: nián huá: time, the years going by.

glosses.zh: 凭高：登到高处往远看。
glosses.en: píng gāo: climbing high to look far.

glosses.zh: 天涯：天边，指朋友所在的远方。
glosses.en: tiān yá: the edge of the sky, the far place where the friend is.

glosses.zh: 更消他：还能经受得住多少。消，经受、禁得住。
glosses.en: gèng xiāo tā: how much more can one bear. Xiāo here means to endure.

glosses.zh: 几度：几回。
glosses.en: jǐ dù: how many times.

translation.zh: 院子背阴的地方还留着残雪，
translation.en: Old snow lingers in the shady courtyard.

translation.zh: 帘影里透着微微的寒意。
translation.en: A light chill hangs in the shadow of the curtain.

translation.zh: 律管里的葭灰纷纷飞出，春天到了。
translation.en: Ash drifts from the jade pipes: spring has come.

translation.zh: 人们写好了金字的春帖，
translation.en: Little spring cards are written in gold,

translation.zh: 可我不知道春天到了谁家。
translation.en: but I do not know whose home spring has reached.

translation.zh: 想念朋友，一整夜在窗前做梦，
translation.en: Missing you, I dream all night by the window.

translation.zh: 无奈那个人，
translation.en: But you, my friend,

translation.zh: 被江水隔开，被天边挡住。
translation.en: are cut off by water and hidden by the sky.

translation.zh: 只有我伤心地看着，
translation.en: All I have is sorrow,

translation.zh: 满树梅花的幽香，
translation.en: a whole tree of quiet plum scent,

translation.zh: 满地横斜的梅影。
translation.en: and plum shadows lying slant across the ground.

translation.zh: 江南本来就让人离愁满怀，
translation.en: In the south, parting is already a heavy sorrow,

translation.zh: 何况还有古道上远行的马，
translation.en: let alone travelers' horses on the old road,

translation.zh: 北归的大雁落在平坦的沙滩。
translation.en: and homing geese landing on the flat sand.

translation.zh: 怎么才能得到一张银笺，
translation.en: How can I find fine letter paper

translation.zh: 细细地对你说说这些年的光景？
translation.en: and tell you warmly about the passing years?

translation.zh: 如今到处都长满了芳草，
translation.en: Now sweet grass grows everywhere.

translation.zh: 就算登上高处，
translation.en: Even if I climb high,

translation.zh: 也看不见天边的你。
translation.en: I cannot see you at the edge of the sky.

translation.zh: 还能经受得住，
translation.en: How much more can I bear:

translation.zh: 几回东风，
translation.en: how many more east winds,

translation.zh: 几回落花？
translation.en: how many more falling flowers?

background.zh: 周密号草窗，他写过一首《高阳台》，寄给越中（今浙江绍兴一带）的朋友们。王沂孙是会稽（今绍兴）人，是周密的好朋友，就用同样的韵脚写了这首词来回答。这种写法叫“和韵”。词里写早春时节，梅花开了，作者却因为和朋友分离，感受不到春天的快乐。具体写作年份不清楚。
background.en: Zhou Mi, called Caochuang, wrote a lyric to the same tune and sent it to his friends in Yue, the area around today's Shaoxing in Zhejiang. Wang Yisun came from Kuaiji, today's Shaoxing, and was Zhou Mi's good friend. He answered with this lyric, using the same rhyme words. This is called matching rhymes. It is early spring, the plum is in bloom, but parted from his friend, the poet cannot feel spring's joy. The exact year is not known.

author_note.zh: 王沂孙，号碧山，会稽人，是南宋末年的词人。他最擅长写咏物词，就是借写一样东西，比如梅花、蝉、月亮，来表达自己的心事。他和周密、张炎等人常常一起写词唱和。
author_note.en: Wang Yisun, also called Bishan, came from Kuaiji and was a ci poet at the end of the Southern Song. He was best at lyrics about objects, using plum blossom, a cicada or the moon to speak his own heart. He often wrote and traded lyrics with friends such as Zhou Mi and Zhang Yan.

appreciation.zh: 上半首先写早春：残雪、轻寒、葭灰飞、金字春帖，样样都在说春天来了，作者却问“不知春在谁家”，好像春天和他没有关系。原来他整夜梦见朋友，可朋友隔着江水、天边。醒来只看到满树梅香、满地梅影，越美越孤单。下半首写古道上的行马、落在沙滩上的归雁，想写信又不知从何说起。最后芳草长满天涯，登高也望不见人，还要再经历多少回东风、多少回落花。一层层的春景，都变成了一层层的思念。
appreciation.en: The first half shows early spring: old snow, a light chill, flying ash in the pipes, gold spring cards. Everything says spring has come, yet the poet asks whose home it has reached, as if spring has nothing to do with him. He has dreamed of his friend all night, but the friend is beyond the water and the sky. Waking, he sees only plum scent and plum shadows, and the more lovely they are, the lonelier he feels. In the second half come horses on the old road and homing geese landing on the sand. He wants to write, but where to begin? At last sweet grass covers the far horizon, and even from a height he cannot see his friend. How many more east winds and falling flowers must he live through? Layer upon layer of spring becomes layer upon layer of longing.
